name: Department of Pediatrics research (Le Bonheur)
org: UT Health Science Center / Le Bonheur Children's Hospital
focus: Pediatric research at Le Bonheur, including a well-regarded neuroscience and epilepsy group.
notes: Same city as St. Jude. If you are applying to POE anyway, a direct email here costs nothing, and the pediatric epilepsy work overlaps with the Boston Children's lab on your list. Likely arranged by direct contact rather than a portal.

name: Department of Pediatrics research opportunities (Riley Children's)
org: Indiana University School of Medicine / Riley Children's Health
focus: Pediatric research across IU's Department of Pediatrics at Riley Children's.
notes: The department page lists training only for physicians, residents and faculty, with no undergraduate program and no application. The only way in is emailing a faculty member whose work you like. INSPIRE and the Medical Neuroscience program above are the real Indiana applications.

name: Duke Summer Research Opportunity Program (SROP)
category: Academic medical centers & med school SURPs
focus: Research placements across Duke including a well-regarded neuroscience track.
stipend_note: Competitive stipend plus shared on-campus housing and travel help; no figure posted
notes: The program was not held in 2026, and the page still says to check back in fall 2026 for summer 2027. Nothing is posted yet. Nine weeks of biomedical research, shared on-campus housing, travel help and a stipend, aimed at students considering a PhD.

name: Education & training programs
focus: Neurology and neurosurgery research at one of the largest dedicated neurological institutes in the world.
notes: Strong clinical neuroscience exposure, which is harder to find than bench neuroscience. Pairs with Phoenix Children's for one city.

name: Emergency Department Clinical Research Internship
focus: Hands-on pediatric emergency medicine clinical research, patient enrollment and data collection in the ED.
stipend_note: Unpaid; the page says a stipend may be available
notes: The posted cycle is a FALL-SPRING internship (Sept 2026 to May 2027), not a summer program, and the page says nothing about summer. It is real pediatric emergency patient contact, which is rare, so email the program manager, Desiree Edemba, to ask whether a summer 2027 session runs. Do not plan your summer around it. About an hour from Leesburg.

name: NIA Alzheimer's Disease Research Centers: directory
focus: The master directory of NIA-funded Alzheimer's Disease Research Centers.
notes: Not a program: a hunting ground. Pick the three centers nearest you and email the education coordinator at each. Most do not advertise undergraduate slots but will take a strong student who asks. The single highest-leverage move for an Alzheimer's interest.

name: Neuroscience & Cell Biology Summer Research
org: Rutgers Robert Wood Johnson Medical School
focus: Neuroscience and cell biology research in RWJMS labs.
notes: Flagged on your list: opens Jan 2.

name: Pathways to Science: summer research database
focus: The best free aggregator of funded undergraduate summer research programs, searchable by discipline and deadline.
notes: Use this as a monthly sweep to catch programs this list does not have. Sort by deadline.

name: Pediatric Epilepsy Research Internship (Loddenkemper Lab)
focus: Pediatric epilepsy and EEG research in a single high-output lab.
stipend_note: Unpaid: you need academic credit from your school or outside funding
notes: Unpaid, 30 hours a week, with a remote option. Send questions only to LoddenkemperInternship@childrens.harvard.edu, not to lab members. The page still shows last cycle's dates, so check it from early January.

name: Pediatrics summer research (Benioff Children's)
focus: Pediatric research across UCSF's Department of Pediatrics.
notes: The department page offers student programs for medical students only, with no undergraduate application. Placements like this come from emailing a faculty member directly; the Emailing a lab guide on this site walks you through it.

name: Rebecca D. Considine Research Institute summer programs
focus: Pediatric clinical research at a mid-size children's hospital.
notes: Genuine safety. Ohio now has five options on this list, Cincinnati, Nationwide, the two Case Western programs, Cleveland Clinic and this.

name: Research & Innovation summer opportunities
focus: Pediatric clinical and translational research, affiliated with UConn Health.
notes: Close to Yale, so a New Haven / Hartford trip could cover both this and the Child Study Center. Smaller applicant pool than the big-name children's hospitals.

name: Research Training & Internships
focus: Multiple pediatric research internship tracks across the institute.
stipend_note: $4,400 in 2026, meant to cover travel and housing; no housing is provided
notes: The page still shows the 2026 cycle (applications Dec 1, 2025 to Feb 1, 2026), so 2027 dates are not posted. You rank three mentors in the application. Email ResearchInternship@childrenscolorado.org to ask when 2027 opens.

name: Research and education programs
category: Commutable from home (DC metro and Virginia)
focus: Northern Virginia's largest health system, with clinical and translational research including Inova Children's Hospital.
notes: About 35 minutes from Leesburg, so no housing cost. You already worked in Fairfax at Privia, so you know the area and may have a contact who can point you at the right person. This is a hub page: the summer research listings sit under research and education, and a direct email is likely to work better than a portal.

name: Research opportunities
org: George Washington University School of Medicine
category: Commutable from home (DC metro and Virginia)
focus: Clinical and translational research in downtown DC, with ties to Children's National.
notes: GW's pediatrics department is based at Children's National, so an email here can lead to the same place by another route.

name: Simmons Cancer Center education & training
org: UT Southwestern Harold C. Simmons Comprehensive Cancer Center
focus: Cancer-focused summer research training at UT Southwestern.
notes: Second UT Southwestern route alongside SURF, which is also an Amgen host, three paths into the same institution.

name: Strong Children's Research Center Summer Training Program
org: University of Rochester Medical Center, Department of Pediatrics
focus: Ten weeks on a project with a pediatrics faculty mentor in the specialty you choose, ending in a poster session for the whole Department of Pediatrics. Running for the 37th year.
stipend_note: $3,000 plus free on-campus housing; travel is yours
notes: CONFIRMED on the page: the 2027 application opened Monday, Nov 16, 2026, and applications are reviewed on a rolling basis, so earlier is better. It wants official transcripts that include your fall 2026 semester, so you can submit once fall grades post. Two faculty letters, a CV and short answers. You are placed with a mentor in the pediatric specialty you pick.

name: Student Research Programs
focus: Campus-level undergraduate research program listings.
notes: The weakest entry on your list unless you have an ODU connection. This is a general campus page, not a competitive national program.

name: Summer Research Program
focus: Pediatric clinical research, including a notable pediatric epilepsy and neurosciences group.
notes: Their pediatric neurosciences/epilepsy work overlaps with the Boston Children's epilepsy interest, a good direct-email target.

name: Summer Undergraduate Research Programs: searchable database
focus: The AAMC's own index of summer research programs at US medical schools, searchable by state and institution.
notes: Complements Pathways to Science rather than duplicating it: this one is specifically medical schools, which is exactly the right slice. Worth a monthly sweep alongside the NSF REU portal.

name: Summer education programs
focus: Cancer research at the oldest cancer center in the United States.
notes: Markedly less contested than MSK or Dana-Farber while still being an NCI comprehensive cancer center.

name: Summer research
org: Fralin Biomedical Research Institute at Virginia Tech Carilion
category: Commutable from home (DC metro and Virginia)
focus: Neuroscience-heavy institute with work on addiction, developmental neuroscience and human neuroimaging.
notes: Not commutable from Leesburg, but a genuinely strong neuroscience institute in Virginia that very few people outside the state apply to. The human neuroimaging work is close to what you already do in the lab.

name: Summer research programs
category: Commutable from home (DC metro and Virginia)
focus: Medical school research across neuroscience and the Lombardi Comprehensive Cancer Center.
notes: Roughly an hour from Leesburg. Lombardi is an NCI comprehensive cancer center, and the neuroscience department is strong. Hub page: look under education and training for the summer listings.

name: Summer research programs
org: University of Virginia School of Medicine
category: Commutable from home (DC metro and Virginia)
focus: Biomedical research at Virginia's flagship medical school, including UVA Children's.
notes: About two hours from Leesburg, so a weekend drive home rather than a commute. In-state and a strong pediatrics department.

name: Undergraduate Scholars / student programs
focus: Neuroscience and imaging research at HHMI's dedicated research campus, with an unusually strong tools-and-methods culture.
notes: In Ashburn, about 15 minutes from Leesburg. Summer undergraduates now come through HHMI's Cech Fellows Program, nine weeks, so check the Cech Fellows page for the deadline and stipend. The Janelia and Loudoun County internship listed beside it is for high school students. Small and very selective, and best if you lean computational or imaging.

name: Undergraduate research fellowships
focus: Regeneration, aging and comparative biology at a small marine and biomedical research institute.
notes: Same town as the Jackson Laboratory, so one Bar Harbor application trip covers both, and this one is far less contested than JAX.
